# MongoDB Indexing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Database > MongoDB

## Overview

Designs MongoDB index strategies including compound indexes, text indexes, wildcard indexes, and atlas search for query optimization

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [mongodb-indexing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
mongodb-indexing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@mongodb-indexing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design compound indexes with proper field ordering
- Create text indexes for full-text search
- Implement geospatial indexes for location queries
- Use wildcard indexes for dynamic field patterns

## Technology Standards Applied

- **MongoDB Indexes**: Index type selection and design guidelines
- **ESR Rule**: Equality, Sort, Range ordering for compound indexes
- **Atlas Search**: Full-text search with Lucene-based indexes
